issue_context.title: Wasm loading should fallback to `instantiate` if `instantiateStreaming` fails due to incorrect MIME type
issue_context.body:
## Feature request

**What is the expected behavior?**
When using a Wasm file with `experiments.(a)syncWebAssembly: true`, the Wasm module will fail to load if the server does not serve the file with the application/wasm MIME type:
`TypeError: Failed to execute 'compile' on 'WebAssembly': Incorrect response MIME type. Expected 'application/wasm'`

Source that instantiates the Wasm:
https://github.com/webpack/webpack/blob/af52c8f0457b1055098d6b7b545b257404d06c93/lib/wasm-sync/WasmChunkLoadingRuntimeModule.js#L304-L311

The loader could detect this and attempt to fallback to `WebAssembly.instantiate` in this case so that the app can continue to function.

Compare the behavior of the loading code in `wasm-bindgen`:
https://github.com/rustwasm/wasm-bindgen/blob/b584407a46a1b9f517d0f606fff954aaa079fa6b/crates/cli-support/src/js/mod.rs#L684-L710

**What is motivation or use case for adding/changing the behavior?**
This would allow the app to continue to work in cases where the server is not configured for the proper MIME type and is not easily configurable.

**How should this be implemented in your opinion?**
Catch the error thrown when trying to `instantiateStreaming`, possibly inspect `response.headers`, and fall back to `WebAssembly.instantiate`.

**Are you willing to work on this yourself?**
No
comments: it means that your webserver doesn't set the proper mime type when serving the wasm file. You should consider upgrading to the latest version

The issue is my application is hosted by end-users on their own server; often their server is not configurable (hosted by a third party) or they lack the knowledge to do so. As serving with the proper MIME type still seems to be the exception, not the norm, this is [the number one support request](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/issues/506) for my app [despite putting some significant effort in documentation](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/wiki/Using-Ruffle#configure-webassembly-mime-type). Thank you!
